classification: post-disclosure development experiment; not blind evidence
target: published R29 r29_pick_heavy_opposite open-gripper physical tool contact

mechanism.source: the existing causal NormalForce estimate from encoder and JTS, projected against the normalized public commanded TCP velocity
mechanism.eligibility: gripper open and commanded TCP speed at least 0.01 m/s
mechanism.signed_evidence: minus dot(world force, normalized commanded TCP velocity)
mechanism.threshold_rationale: ten times the already frozen 0.5 N measured normal resolution; not fitted to the disclosed 12.51 N target peak
mechanism.arbitration: base is never suppressed; optional report fires only when the base is not already high and cannot rearm until physical evidence releases

known_gates.target: weak contact gets one attributable rise after physical contact and no prealarm
known_gates.matched: same mass/COM/mechanics at zero offset gets no rise
known_gates.strong_tools: three published high-offset tools retain first rise within +5 ms, with no added duplicate or more than +5 active samples
known_gates.signed_and_matched: published signed forced rows and matched twins have no lost rise, added false rise, duplicate, or delay over +5 ms
known_gates.physics: all force and physical hashes remain exact
known_gates.official: run original official controls only after targeted guards pass

independent_after_freeze: one small fixed offset matrix may run after candidate freeze; no threshold or code change is permitted from its outcomes
falsifier: reject on target miss, matched false edge, any protected loss/delay/duplicate/duration regression, or a new false/tool prealarm; do not try another threshold
